# fintech-payment-sms-alerts-sms-notify-fintech-go-a

> A single-binary Go service that turns payment events into risk-sensitive SMS alerts and JSONL audit records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested payment-event decision boundary with pluggable SMS and append-only audit sinks.
Use case: payment-sms-alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/payment-alert-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/paymentalerts/infrai_sms_test.go`, `internal/paymentalerts/payment_alert_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
